/ / / 04 · How It Is Split

The Three Ad Groups

The campaign is split so each ad matches what the person actually searched.

  • Brand and Commercial Video: brands and marketing teams searching for commercial and brand film production. This is the lead group.
  • Corporate and Cause Video: corporate, faith and cause work. A vertical, not the headline service.
  • Regional Video Production: people searching by place (Pensacola, Gulf Coast, Mobile, NW Florida).

/ / / 10 · SEO And Local Progress

The Rest Of This Month

  • Blog: live with 2 posts. Page titles tightened on 13 city and service pages, and schema signals added so Google knows who you are and where you work.
  • Site health: 24 pages, 96 out of 100 health score, 0 errors.
  • Local: tracking set up for your Google Business Profile, reviews and directories. You're listed on 6 of the 58 directories we track (all Google-fed). Bing and Apple Maps are next.
  • Reviews: 13 reviews at 5.0. 2 are unanswered and there haven't been any new ones since June.
  • Rankings: your brand name ranked #1 daily from August 29 through September 25 in our tracker, then dropped out of the top 100 from September 26. Search Console shows your homepage is still indexed with no penalties. I'm digging into the cause and will report back.
